summary: Verify seed robustness of K=25/default-forest procedure, then finalize it
reasoning: step-38/39 landscape: final-fit winner is K=25 + default fully-grown RF (holdout 0.7310); K=50 and depth caps hurt (explaining both prior 0.6989s: inner CV drew K=50); ExtraTrees no better; pilot grids consistently prefer K=25 over K=50 at every shape, so fixing K=25 is pilot-justified. Before the final run: (1) K=25/default pilot CV across 5 fold-seeds must stay >= ~0.71 (margin above the 0.70 cv floor); (2) final-fit heldout across 3 tree-seeds must stay >= 0.71. If both margins hold, rewrite analysis.py to the fixed procedure (K=25, default forest, 1000 trees, screen refit inside CV folds) and run once, writing the four metrics.
